settings.headline:
Stories that
hold together.
settings.copy: Common Thread is an independent podcast network producing shows about the people, places, and ideas that quietly shape how we live. We record, edit, and distribute everything in-house — so every episode sounds like it belongs to the same family.

trust_list.text: Six original shows, one shared sound
Recorded and edited in our own studio

settings.title: Six shows,
settings.intro: Every Common Thread show starts with a question worth sitting with. Here's what's on the network right now.

features.title: The Long Way Home
features.text: A documentary series following people who left the places they grew up — and the reasons they keep going back. Quiet, patient, and deeply human.

features.title: Field Notes
features.text: Scientists, farmers, and naturalists on the small observations that change how we understand the world. Recorded in the field, not the studio.

features.title: The Workbench
features.text: Makers and craftspeople on the tools, materials, and habits behind the things they build. For anyone who loves a well-made object.

features.title: Second Reading
features.text: Two editors revisit a book they loved twenty years ago and ask whether it still holds up. Honest, funny, and occasionally wrong.

features.title: The Night Shift
features.text: Stories from people who work while the rest of us sleep — nurses, bakers, truckers, and the quiet hours that shape their lives.

features.title: Common Ground
features.text: A conversation show where guests who disagree on everything find one thing they can agree on. Recorded in front of a live audience.

settings.title: Wherever you
settings.intro: Every Common Thread show is free on all the major platforms. Members get ad-free episodes, early access, and the occasional behind-the-scenes tape.

steps.title: Pick a show
steps.text: Start with the one that matches your mood — a long drive, a quiet evening, or a commute that needs company.

steps.title: Press play
steps.text: Find us on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or any app you already use. New episodes land every week.

steps.title: Become a member
steps.text: For a few dollars a month, get every episode ad-free, a day early, plus the tapes that never make it to air.

settings.note: Most listeners tell us they start with one show and end up following three. That's the common thread — once you're in, you're in.

settings.title: Heard by
settings.intro: We don't chase the algorithm. We make shows for people who actually listen — and they tell us so.

reviews.quote: The Long Way Home made me call my grandmother. I hadn't called her in months. That's what this network does — it reaches in and reminds you what matters.
reviews.author: Maya Chen

reviews.quote: I've listened to a lot of podcasts, and Common Thread is the only network where every show sounds like it was made with care. You can hear the difference.
reviews.author: Daniel Osei

reviews.quote: Field Notes got me back into birdwatching. I never expected a podcast to do that. The production quality is genuinely beautiful.
reviews.author: Ruth Alvarez

settings.title: Have a story
settings.intro: Whether you're a writer with a pitch, a brand looking to sponsor responsibly, or a listener with a story to share — we'd love to hear from you.

settings.blurb: An independent podcast network producing shows about the people, places, and ideas that quietly shape how we live.
